title: SOAP login() from a broad IP range needs a security token from 2026-12-15
summary: Starting 2026-12-15 in sandboxes and 2027-01-31 in production, SOAP API login() for a user whose org or profile login IP range is broad (larger than /8 IPv4 or /29 IPv6) fails without a security token (or mTLS); username and password alone fail with TOKEN_REQUIRED (Login History result 1502). It applies to login() on /services/Soap/c/{v} and /services/Soap/u/{v} in API 31.0-64.0.
migrationNote: Preferably switch the integration to an External Client App with OAuth 2.0 before 2026-12-15 (sandbox) / 2027-01-31 (production). As a stopgap, append the user's security token to the password in the login() call, or narrow the org Network Access or profile Login IP Ranges so they are no longer broad; test with the 'SOAP API login() Security Remediation' release update.
